 Class 3 girl dies after suffering cardiac arrest in school
 Source: PTI   -   Edited By: Hemant Waje 
 November 04, 2026 19:04 IST 
 2 Minutes Read 
 Summarize this -->
 Listen to this article 
 Share this Article 
 x 
 A nine-year-old Class 3 student tragically died from a cardiac arrest inside her classroom in Delhi school. 
 Kindly note the image has been posted only for representational purposes. Photograph: Kind courtesy Pexels.com 
 Key Points
 A nine-year-old Class 3 girl died on Wednesday morning after suffering a cardiac arrest in her classroom at Lovely Public School in Mayur Vihar.
 The incident occurred when the girl collapsed while standing in front of her class teacher, and the entire episode was captured by the school's CCTV cameras.
 School officials immediately rushed the girl to a private hospital, where doctors declared her brought dead.
 Police are investigating the incident, examining CCTV footage, and will record statements from the girl's parents and school authorities.
 A nine-year-old class 3 girl died after suffering a cardiac arrest inside her classroom at Delhi's Lovely Public School in Mayur Vihar on Wednesday morning, police said.
 Tragic Incident Captured On CCTV
 The incident happened when the girl was standing in front of her class teacher and suddenly collapsed; the school's CCTV cameras also captured the entire episode.
 Police received a PCR call around 9:52 am, following which they initiated an investigation.
 According to police, school officials rushed the girl to a private hospital in Nirman Vihar, east Delhi, where doctors declared her brought dead. School principal Dr Bhavna said the girl collapsed while she was standing in front of her teacher in the classroom.
 "We immediately rushed her to a nearby private hospital. They told us to take her to some other higher centre. We took her to another hospital. Our staff members also informed her family members. The hospital told us that the girl suffered cardiac arrest. Police were informed about the matter," the principal said.
 Police Investigation Underway
 During the preliminary investigation, police examined CCTV footage from the classroom, which showed the girl standing inside the classroom and attempting to approach her class teacher when she suddenly collapsed, an officer said.
 The footage showed the teacher immediately rushing to her aid, picking her up and trying to make her sit on a chair. Several other students are seen gathering around the girl, while some of her classmates rush out of the classroom to alert the school authorities about the incident.
 The police officer said the incident was under investigation and that statements from the girl's parents and the relevant school authorities would be recorded.
